name: Las Ventas de Retamosa (Spain)
description: Divided by a green diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white above and blue below.
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 14 January 1994 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 21 April 1994; the flag is rectangular, of proportion 2:3, tierced in bend sinister, the upper part white, the central green and the lower blue.

features.role: band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
